mapper.insert:
insert into stock_recommend_pool ( target_date, stock_code, stock_name, source, score, status, reason, extra, create_time ) values
(#{item.targetDate}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.source}, #{item.score}, #{item.status}, #{item.reason}, #{item.extra}, sysdate())
on duplicate key update stock_name = values(stock_name), score = values(score), status = values(status), reason = values(reason), extra = values(extra)
mapper.select: select id, target_date, stock_code, stock_name, source, score, status, reason, extra, create_time from stock_recommend_pool where target_date = #{targetDate} order by source asc, score desc, stock_code asc
select max(target_date) from stock_recommend_pool where target_date <= #{date}
